AdditionalDetails.description: Additional information provided by the selling party for tax-related or any other purpose.

detail.description: The detail of the additional information provided by the selling party.

languageCode.description: The language code of the additional information detail.

type.description: The type of the additional information provided by the selling party.

AdditionalPartyIdentification.description: An additional corporate or fiscal registration identifier for a party.

identificationNumber.description: The value of the additional party identifier.

identificationType.description: The type of the additional party identifier.

city.description: The city where the person, business or institution is located.

county.description: The county where person, business or institution is located.

district.description: The district where person, business or institution is located.

name.description: The name of the person, business or institution at that address.

phone.description: The phone number of the person, business or institution located at that address.

postalOrZipCode.description: The postal or zip code of that address.

stateOrRegion.description: The state or region where person, business or institution is located.

AllowanceDetails.description: Monetary and tax details of the allowance.

allowanceAmount.description: Total monetary amount related to this allowance.

taxDetails.description: Tax amount details applied on this allowance.

ChargeDetails.description: Monetary and tax details of the charge.

chargeAmount.description: Total monetary amount related to this charge.

taxDetails.description: Tax amount details applied on this charge.

CreditNoteDetails.description: References required in order to process a credit note.

consignorsReferenceNumber.description: Identifies the consignor reference number (VRET number), if generated by Amazon.

coopReferenceNumber.description: Identifies the COOP reference used for COOP agreement.

debitNoteNumber.description: Debit Note Number as generated by Amazon.

goodsReturnDate.description: Date that a return is received by the vendor.

originalInvoiceDate.description: Date of the original invoice that this credit note references.

referenceInvoiceNumber.description: Original Invoice Number when sending a credit note relating to an existing invoice.

rmaId.description: Identifies the Returned Merchandise Authorization ID, if generated.

DateTime.description: Defines a date and time according to ISO8601.

Decimal.description: A decimal number with no loss of precision.

Error.description: Error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

details.description: Additional details that can help the caller understand or fix the issue.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

Invoice.description: Represents an invoice or credit note document with details about the transaction, parties involved, and line items.

additionalDetails.description: Additional details provided by the selling party, for tax related or other purposes.

allowanceDetails.description: Total allowance amount details for all line items.

billFromParty.description: Name, address and tax details of the party that issues this invoice.

billToParty.description: Name, address and tax details of the party to whom this invoice is issued.

chargeDetails.description: Total charge amount details for all line items.

date.description: Date when the invoice/credit note information was generated in the origin's accounting system.

id.description: Unique number relating to the charges defined in this document.

invoiceBaseAmount.description: Sum of all invoice line net amounts, excluding tax, charges and allowances.

invoiceTotal.description: Total monetary amount charged in the invoice or full value of credit note to be paid including all relevant taxes.

paymentTerms.description: The payment terms for the invoice.

referenceNumber.description: An additional unique reference number used for regulatory or other purposes.

remitToParty.description: Name, address and tax details of the party receiving the payment of this invoice.

shipFromParty.description: Name, address and tax details of the party sending a shipment of products.

shipToParty.description: Name, address and tax details of the party receiving a shipment of products.

taxDetails.description: Total tax amount details for all line items.

taxPointDate.description: The date on which the tax becomes chargeable, if different from the invoice date.

taxRepresentativeParty.description: Name, address and tax registration details of the supplier's fiscal or tax representative, where one is required.

vatGroupParty.description: Name, address and tax registration details of the VAT group representative member, when the supplier reports VAT as part of a VAT group.

additionalDetails.description: Line-level additional details provided by the selling party, e.g.

amazonProductIdentifier.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) of an item.

chargeDetails.description: Individual charge details per line item.

creditNoteDetails.description: Details required in order to process a credit note.

itemDescription.description: Product or service description for the invoiced line item.

itemSequenceNumber.description: Unique number related to this line item.

netCost.description: The item cost to Amazon, which should match the cost on the order.

netCostUnitOfMeasure.description: This field represents weight unit of measure of items that are ordered by cases and supporting priced by weight.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The Amazon purchase order number for this invoiced line item.

taxDetails.description: Individual tax details per line item.

vendorProductIdentifier.description: The vendor selected product identifier of the item.

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure for the quantity.

unitSize.description: The case size, if the unit of measure value is Cases.

Money.description: An amount of money, including units in the form of currency.

currencyCode.description: Three-digit currency code in ISO 4217 format.

NetCostUnitOfMeasure.description: This field represents weight unit of measure of items that are ordered by cases and supporting priced by weight.

PartyIdentification.description: Name, address and tax details of a party.

additionalPartyIdentifications.description: Additional corporate or fiscal registration identifiers for the party that are not VAT/GST registrations (e.g.

address.description: Identification of the party by address.

taxRegistrationDetails.description: Tax registration details of the party.

PaymentTerms.description: Terms of the payment for the invoice.

discountDueDays.description: The number of calendar days from the Base date (Invoice date) until the discount is no longer valid.

discountPercent.description: The discount percent value, which is good until the discount due date.

netDueDays.description: The number of calendar days from the base date (invoice date) until the total amount on the invoice is due.

type.description: The payment term type for the invoice.

SubmitInvoicesRequest.description: The request schema for the submitInvoices operation.

invoices.description: An array of Invoice objects representing the invoices or credit notes to be submitted.

payload.description: The response payload for the submitInvoices operation.

taxAmount.description: Total tax amount applied on invoice total or an item total.

taxRegistrationNumber.description: The tax registration number for the entity.

taxRegistrationType.description: The tax registration type for the entity.

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure for items sold by weight.
